title: KMS Fall Meeting 2026
subtitle: Four student poster presentations and a special-session talk at GIST.

sections.text: MLFE Lab participated in the 2026 Korean Mathematical Society (KMS) Fall Meeting, held at Gwangju Institute of Science and Technology (GIST) from October 29 to 31. Jeonggyu Huh gave a special-session talk, and Hojin Ko, Yoonyoung Byun, Dongwan Shin, and Seungho Na presented posters.
